summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K reporting termination of a purchase and sale agreement (PSA) for the sale of Riverside Apartments, a 1,222-unit community in Alexandria, VA, with a contract price of $280M. The buyer (Beitel Group subsidiary) exercised its termination right during the extended inspection period, resulting in refund of earnest money. This is part of Elme's ongoing liquidation under a shareholder-approved Plan of Sale and Liquidation, with five remaining properties. A separate sale of Elme Watkins Mill closed on June 10, 2026, with proceeds used to repay a $520M term loan. The company withdrew previously provided estimates of liquidating distributions due to the termination. Watch for new marketing efforts and potential buyer pool for Riverside Apartments.
